bibl.title: "Your City is Memphis": A Magical Formulary with a Prose Hymn.
bibl.seg: Michael Zellmann-Rohrer, "Your City is Memphis": A Magical Formulary with a Prose Hymn.
bibl.note: P. Duk. Inv. 751 (ex-P. Coll. privées: P. von Scherling Inv. G 84). Fragment of a magical formulary with portions of instructions for ritual preparations and an invocation in the form of a prose hymn. Provenance unknown, second century CE.
